settings.title: How does CBD help with managing stress?
settings.text: Our bodies naturally produce their own endocannabinoids as a response to stress. Every day we deal with acute stress, and this is healthy. Supplementing your body with CBD is thought to support the endocannabinoid system, helping you deal with the feelings of stress. Discover more about stress and CBD in our blog.

settings.title: Why choose NextEvo stress gummies?
settings.text: Stress CBD Complex Gummies are discrete and easily transported from place to place so you can carry them in your bag or pocket and have them available when you want them. All of our CBD products are fast acting and highly absorbent so they start to get to work in as little as 10 minutes and absorb more CBD than other products*, thanks to our proprietary SmartSorb technology.

settings.title: Should I try other methods to manage stress?
settings.text: Using quality CBD products can help support your endocannabinoid system. There are also many other methods and wellness techniques available to help you become more resilient to stress. Read our blog post on stress and resilience to learn more.

settings.title: How much CBD should I take to deal with stress?
settings.text: This is really a question of experience and will vary from person to person. If you're familiar with CBD products, you may need a higher dosage to feel the benefits whereas somebody using CBD supplements to combat stress for the first time may need a smaller dose. If you regularly find yourself feeling like you need to better manage your daily stress, you should try using CBD gummies regularly to see how they work for you over time. Read more on this here.

settings.title: Does CBD help with stress?
settings.text: CBD has been proven to create a sense of calm and may help support symptoms of stress. It can be taken in many different forms like edibles to have multiple times throughout the day, and capsules to ingest daily.

settings.title: How often should I take CBD for stress?
settings.text:
Always talk to your healthcare provider prior to taking CBD. The most typical dosage of CBD for stress is between 10 mg and 20mg a day.

Try taking one or two of our CBD gummies every day, and you should start seeing an improvement in your stress levels within a week. They’re
crafted with our special SmartSorb™ technology which gives them four times better absorption, so you’ll likely find them to be effective at reducing stress

settings.title: Which CBD is best for stress?
settings.text:
A great way to take CBD for stress is to consume edibles throughout the
day. You can try out different dosages to see what works for you, but we recommend starting small and working your way up to find the perfect amount.

settings.title: When to take CBD for stress?
settings.text:
If you want to relieve stress throughout the day, try taking CBD capsules in the morning with your breakfast.

Our 10 mg capsules are perfect for a daily intake, and you can top up with a 10 mg CBD gummy later on if you need a little support.

settings.title: What is ashwagandha?
settings.text: Ashwagandha is a herb commonly used as an adaptogen to manage stress. Whole-plant extract ashwagandha has been shown to have a significant impact on reducing cortisol levels, increasing DHEA, decreasing stress , improving sleep duration, and increasing energy.

settings.title: Why choose CBD with ashwagandha for stress?
settings.text: CBD can help you feel calm and relaxed, alleviating the feelings of stress. Ashwagandha can reduce cortisol levels, increase mental clarity, and decrease stress.
